title: Apache Kafka connector instance config (loams.flow/v1)
description: One Kafka connector instance's settings: the brokers and topics it reads or writes, the consumer group, and the SASL/TLS material. Covers both directions of the ★ Kafka connector (design §33 §8 row 1; CN1 plan Task 6). Secrets are named, never stored here: `sasl.password` and `tls.key_pem` resolve through the namespace's secret store (D189) and are exactly the manifest's `secrets` list (CN1 Task 1's semantic rule).

brokers.description: Bootstrap brokers as host:port, comma separated. Required: there is no default cluster.

topics.description: Topics this instance reads or writes. A route narrows the set further (§33 D355, `source` in a route).

group_id_prefix.description: Prefix of the consumer group; CN1 Task 6 names the group `loams-<ns>-<instance>`, so this is normally the namespace and instance name the runtime already knows.

group_id.description: Full consumer group id, when an instance overrides the runtime's `loams-<ns>-<instance>` default (CN1 Task 6).

enable_idempotence.description: The idempotent producer (CN1 Task 6: enable.idempotence=true with acks=all). Sink only; it may not be turned off, which is why the manifest declares sink.idempotent: true.

acks.description: The producer's acks setting. all is required with the idempotent producer.

max_poll_records.description: Records per poll; the native source's batch size before the Fabric acknowledges (Ruling 4).

auto_offset_reset.description: Where a group with no committed offset starts. earliest replays the topic; CN1 defaults to latest so a new instance does not ingest history.

security_protocol.description: The transport security (CN1 Task 6: SASL PLAIN/SCRAM over TLS, mTLS, MSK IAM).

sasl.description: SASL material. Present only when security_protocol starts with sasl_.

mechanism.description: The SASL mechanism (the manifest's auth slugs sasl-plain, sasl-scram-256, sasl-scram-512, aws-msk-iam).

password.description: The SASL password. Resolved through the secret store (D189); never stored in the instance (CN1 Global Constraints).

tls.description: TLS material. Present only when security_protocol ends with _ssl or is ssl.

enabled.description: Whether TLS is on at all.

ca_pem.description: The CA bundle that verifies the broker, as PEM.

cert_pem.description: The client certificate for mTLS, as PEM (not a secret).

key_pem.description: The client private key for mTLS, as PEM. Resolved through the secret store (D189).

verify_full.description: Whether the broker certificate's hostname is verified (CN1 Task 6 uses verify-full for the analogous SQL drivers).

delivery.description: The sink's delivery (CN2 Task 9, OR-7): effectively_once is the idempotent producer; exactly_once writes each batch and its checkpoint in one Kafka transaction (transactional.id loams-<ns>-<instance>-<split>, checkpoint in checkpoint_topic). A target profile that narrows sink.transactional (Azure Event Hubs) refuses exactly_once.

checkpoint_topic.description: The compacted topic the transactional sink keeps its checkpoint in (key <ns>/<instance>/<split>).

create_checkpoint_topic.description: Create checkpoint_topic (compacted, one partition) when it is missing.

max_record_bytes.description: The largest record the sink writes (message.max.bytes); a larger event goes to the DLQ as poison.

recover_timeout_ms.description: How long the transactional sink's recovery may read checkpoint_topic.

poll_wait_ms.description: How long the source waits for a first record before it reports nothing.

pipeline.description: The connector SDK's per-instance pipeline overrides (max_batch_rows, max_batch_bytes, linger_ms, max_in_flight_batches, memory_budget_bytes, checkpoint_interval_ms, retry).

schema_registry.description: Confluent registry, for the Avro wire format at the Kafka boundary (D356). Optional because the manifest declares schema.registry: optional (§33 §4).

subject_prefix.description: Subject prefix for this instance's topics.
